build_control.historical_compiler_flags_continuity: UNCONFIRMED; current per-file ARC flags captured. Native controls establish observed numerical continuity, not historical flag identity.
build_control.FAST_configuration_evidence: Object class/format reference and exactly one requested=1/config-getter=1 setup marker per process; controls have none. Not a physical placement/effect proof.

identities.before_after_pins: PASS archive/GGUF/decoder/DAC/five ggml dylibs/source/adapter/replay/fixture/compiler/SDK/actual headers and own objects/binaries/maps

native_parity.coverage_scope: 200 inputs = 1 host-prefill + 199 native calls. Count inferred from exact loop, successful strict API returns and per-call active checks; no profiler counter. Case-end labels overwrite repeats.
native_parity.strict_enforcement: Frozen bridge attaches strict=true; adapter coreml_strict identity alone is not an environment observation.
not_established: Sampled raw float PCM or generated code parity for this hint

timing_protocol.pass_rule: TOTAL candidate mean <=0.95*MODE0 in both sets and aggregate, decode mean lower both sets and aggregate; MODE0 max/min invocation TOTAL drift <=5%, else inconclusive.
timing_protocol.fixed_work_scope: Stage TOTAL excludes model loading and WAV/JSON I/O, includes T5/prefill/decode/sampling/DAC. EOS-suppressed fixed work is not natural speech latency.
timing_protocol.precision: Frozen bench stage JSON emits six significant digits; stderr per-run total0.1ms/audio0.01s/RTF0.001. Derived means/ratios use those emitted rounded values; no original fullprecision claim.

limitations: One prompt on one M2; no general zero-effect, hardware ceiling or 2x claim.
Byte-exact native logits are bounded to the tested teacher histories and resets. All final WAV/PCM16 hashes match, a diagnostic rather than sampled raw-float speech proof.

time-l process elapsed and cumulative peak RSS include loading, warmup, measured calls and file I/O. No caches deleted; first observed processes are not genuine cold-load or isolated first-request measurements.
CPU_AND_NE is a compute-unit policy, not physical ANE-only execution proof.

Original timing attempt stopped before model load/inference because --greedy is unsupported; no samples. Retry omitted it (greedy is default) and excluded only the numeric time-l instructions-retired line from runtime failure matching. All failed artifacts remain retained.
No observer, new trace, sampled Engine audio, HF or ASR evaluation was run for this hint.
